address_pairs.notes: Lee Jungryong uses 형님 in unspoken thoughts and regards Cheon Taemin as an older brother despite having no blood relation.
address_pairs.speaker: 이정룡

continuity: Lee Jungryong is certain that Jin Taekyung has learned a mana cultivation method; its source remains unknown.
Go Jun's strength and speed were inferior to Taekyung's, and Go Jun recognizes Taekyung as an experienced combatant rather than an ordinary monster-only Hunter.
Ares Guild's security team has received instruction in mana cultivation methods and gives Lee Jungryong absolute loyalty.
Lee Jungryong regards Cheon Taemin as an older brother despite no blood relation; he met Cheon at age thirty and has long held him in both respect and fear.
Mentioning Cheon Taemin is an unspoken taboo for Lee Jungryong's subordinates; Go Jun apologized and knelt after doing so.
Lee Jungryong ordered Go Jun to strengthen surveillance of the Peace Guild, assess its personnel, reinforce the security team, and monitor Ares executives and overseas branches.
Team Leader Choi's earlier Peace Guild recruits were diverted by unusually generous offers or disappeared before signing, consistent with pressure from Ares Guild.
Taekyung rejected Choi's offer to terminate the Peace Guild contracts and committed to making the Guild members stronger.
plot: Lee Jungryong restores Go Jun's strength by channeling mana into his injured arm. Go Jun reports that Jin Taekyung's strength and speed surpassed his own, that Taekyung possesses extensive combat experience, and that Taekyung has learned a mana cultivation method. Lee confirms that this explains Taekyung's extraordinary growth and orders Go Jun to intensify surveillance of the Peace Guild, assess its useful personnel, reinforce the security team, and monitor Ares executives and overseas branches.

Lee Jungryong recalls meeting Cheon Taemin at age thirty and becoming captivated by him, regarding the unrelated man as an older brother despite their lack of blood relation. Meanwhile, Team Leader Choi explains the pressure Lee placed on him and the Peace Guild, then offers to terminate the Guild's contracts to protect its members. Taekyung rejects the offer and declares that they will become stronger, promising to make them strong himself.

active_continuity: Lee Jungryong restored Go Jun by channeling mana into him after Taekyung defeated him.
Go Jun reports that Taekyung's strength and speed exceeded his own and that Taekyung has extensive combat experience.
Lee Jungryong is certain that Taekyung learned a mana cultivation method; how Taekyung obtained it is unknown.
Team Leader Choi and Kim Hwajong did not learn a mana cultivation method.
Ares Guild's security team has been taught mana cultivation methods and is absolutely loyal to Lee Jungryong.
Lee Jungryong regards Cheon Taemin as an older brother despite no blood relation and has respected and feared him since meeting him at age thirty.
Cheon Taemin must not be mentioned casually in Lee Jungryong's presence; Go Jun was reprimanded for invoking him.
Lee Jungryong ordered expanded surveillance of the Peace Guild, assessment of its useful personnel, security-team reinforcement, and monitoring of Ares executives and overseas branches.
Team Leader Choi's overseas transfers, surveillance, and difficulty recruiting for the Peace Guild resulted from Lee Jungryong's pressure.
Taekyung rejected Choi's proposed contract termination and promised to make the Peace Guild stronger.
open_questions: Who taught Jin Taekyung the mana cultivation method?
What history led Lee Jungryong to regard the unrelated Cheon Taemin as his older brother?
temporary_decisions: Render 마나 연공법 as "mana cultivation method."
Render 형님 as "older brother" in Lee Jungryong's internal address to Cheon Taemin while preserving the chosen-kinship context.
